parameters.name: ImageCacheId
parameters.description: The ID of the image cache.

parameters.name: ImageCacheName
parameters.description: The name of the image cache.

parameters.name: ImageFullMatch
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform an exact match for the container images.
This parameter is used to further filter the query results when \`MatchImage\` is specified.

parameters.name: ImageMatchCountRequest
parameters.description:
The number of image caches that exactly match the container images.
This parameter is used to further filter the query results when \`MatchImage\` is specified.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return.

parameters.name: MatchImage
parameters.description: The container images that are used to query the matched image caches. You can specify up to 100 images.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used for the next query. You can obtain the token from the \`NextToken\` parameter in the response to the previous API call.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the image cache belongs.

parameters.name: SnapshotId
parameters.description: The ID of the snapshot that corresponds to the image cache.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that are attached to the image cache.
